test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The directive principles are largely classified into three broad categories. Which of the following is NOT the part of this classification?
solution:
The correct answer is **Authoritative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy** are guidelines for the framing of laws by the government.
 
• They are classified into three broad categories: **Liberal**, **Socialistic**, and **Gandhian**.
 
• **Authoritative** is not a classification of Directive Principles.
 
• The purpose of these principles is to create social and economic conditions under which citizens can lead a good life.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Liberal
 Emphasizes individual freedoms and rights.
 
 

 Socialistic
 Aims at providing social and economic justice.
 
 

 Gandhian
 Based on the principles advocated by Mahatma Gandhi, focusing on rural development and self-sufficiency.
